resources.string: This alpha version cannot use your existing local database. Reset permanently deletes account records, messages, drafts, unsent messages, and local-only threads on this device. You will need to add your accounts again. Server archives cannot restore drafts, unsent messages, or local-only threads. Saved credentials and app preferences are not deleted.
Reset could not finish. Check available storage and try again. Nema has not started a session.
Nema could not open its database. Retry opens it without deleting data. Check available storage and try again.
This database was created by a newer Nema version. Install that version or a newer one to continue. Your local data has not been reset.
